note: How the brawl's cues become sound (audio/audio_brawl.gd; plan in docs/audio/brawl-cues.md). Since C2 the damage event's kind is the strength (light, medium, heavy; guard for a guarded blow), so `kind_is_strength` is on. The attacker's `blow` cue (text light, medium, heavy, bolt, blast, release) still gives a guarded hit its strength, and with `kind_is_strength` off it is the whole answer, falling back to the damage amount. Everything tunable is here.

flurry.note: A run of lights is 5 to 10 blows a second (taps 6 to 12 ticks apart, a burst 4 to 11). Every blow keeps its sound, since each press is a blow, but from the third in a second it is 2 dB down and climbing in pitch, and from the fifth it is the `lite` knock: the same click with half the body and tail, so a run reads as a rattle and not a pile. The blow that closes the run is the full light at +3 dB.

launcher.caption: [ready]

close.note: Encounter's C2: text `used` when his B is thrown (the ping is cut, the launch's own sound confirms), `lapsed` when the opening ends (it rings out).

launcher.note: One sound for every fighter, with no random spread in pitch or level: it is learned by ear, and both players hear it (EP ruling). It plays on its own bus (Alert), because it ducks Sfx and Music and must not duck itself.

windup.note: The gather is sized to the cue's `dur` (the wind-up alone, in live ticks): pitch = nominal ticks over dur, so it peaks as the blow lands. The cue's `n` is the landing tick, which also counts the ticks a press spends closing the gap; the gather waits those ticks (live ticks, so a hit-stop does not shift it). A wind-up stopped by a blow (k 2) or lost (k 3) is faded out; thrown (k 1) and a miss (k 4) let it finish.

energy.note: Energy in reach (docs/vfx/reach.md): a bolt has no gather (2 ticks) and one crack at the landing; a blast gathers for 12 ticks and lands with a whump. A mashed bolt (up to 10 a second) steps down 3 dB and loses its zap from the fifth in a second, so it never strobes in sound as the flash must not in light.

charge.note: The hum starts on the `windup` cue with text `charge` (tick 32 of a held B) and is cut by the release (the `blow` cue with text `release`, 4 ticks before the landing), or by the wind-up's end if it was stopped. `charge_full` (44) is the tick: one fixed sound, exact to the event. While a heavy winds or charges it is armoured: a light never ends it and a medium only before live tick 20 (counted from the wind-up's own start, after the gap is closed); a hit that does not end it gets the dull absorbed tick under it.
